summary.en: Yuhan combines lung-cancer lifecycle development with allergy, metabolic and oncology candidates. Its pipeline includes several early clinical programmes and externally sourced innovation.
summary.zh: Yuhan 将肺癌产品生命周期开发与过敏、代谢和肿瘤候选药物相结合。其管线包括多个早期临床项目和外部引进的创新产品。

gaps: Company-wide counts by phase were not verified; counts is null. Unverified codes, mechanisms, modalities, origins and milestone dates are null rather than inferred.

The Q3 IR index loaded but its presentation attachments were not exposed by the browser; the pipeline and September release supply the asset evidence. The sustainability report pipeline snapshot is May 2026, older than June 2026.

YH32367 and YH32364 combined Phase 1/2 studies are represented as phase 2; this does not establish completion of dose escalation. YH42946 remains phase 1 because the September release says expansion is still planned.

The mobile page contains inconsistent stage labels for YH35324 and YH34160. The report verifies YH35324 as Phase 2; YH34160 is omitted because its current clinical status was not resolved. YH25724 and YH35995 are not promoted beyond the verified Phase 1 descriptions.
Origins other than the explicitly licensed YH42946 were not verified. The modality of YH14618 was not established from the cited descriptions. Most selected assets have no verified next milestone.

Final curl -sSIL checks were attempted for every cited URL on 2026-11-17. All 57 unique URLs returned HTTP 000 with curl exit 6 because this environment could not resolve hosts. Browser-loaded sources support the entries, but independent HTTP-status verification could not be completed.
